requirement: Implement Build Tracker rows 0.7 and 0.8: accessible user settings and reliable JSON save persistence.

architecture.decision: Settings persist independently in ConfigFile and drive Weirdness through a narrow accessibility method; SaveData is a pure value resource while GameState owns versioned JSON serialization and atomic slot replacement.
alternatives: Let UI write shader parameters directly
tradeoffs: Keeping settings outside a playthrough preserves accessibility choices across New Game; the narrow Weirdness seam proves reduce-flashing changes the material; JSON stays portable across engine versions at the cost of explicit type normalization.
seams: Settings never gates gameplay verbs and is registered after Tokens and Weirdness.
Only GameState.deserialize rebuilds JSON String keys as StringName and checkpoint position arrays as Vector2.
write_atomic writes a temp sibling then renames it over the slot; no manual save UI or alternate slot is introduced.

tasks.title: Persist the three accessibility settings and apply flashing reduction
tasks.intent: Add the Settings autoload backed by user://settings.cfg and ensure reduce_flashing clamps a bound Weirdness shader material's aberration_px.
constraints: Only text_effects_enabled, text_scale, and reduce_flashing ship in this row.
Text scale is limited to 1.0, 1.25, or 1.5.
Settings is not part of SaveData and never controls InputMap/gameplay verbs.
tasks.acceptance: Settings load/save through ConfigFile, survive GameState.new_game(), and reduce_flashing changes aberration_px from 6.0 to at most 0.3 on a bound Weirdness material.
tasks.result: Settings persists the three accessibility preferences through ConfigFile and pushes reduce_flashing into Weirdness, which clamps a bound material's aberration_px to 0.3.

tasks.title: Add typed JSON save data and atomic slot replacement
tasks.intent: Implement SaveData and GameState.data with version refusal, StringName/Vector2 normalization, and temp-then-rename writes.
constraints: All persisted game fields live under GameState.data.
Deserialize is the only normalization boundary.
Atomic writes target slot 0 and must preserve an older valid slot if interrupted before rename.
tasks.acceptance: A complete SaveData round-trip preserves fields and key/value types, newer save versions are refused, a simulated interrupted save leaves the previous slot loadable, and New Game replaces data without touching Settings.
tasks.result: SaveData is the complete persisted value, while GameState owns versioned JSON normalization and temp-then-rename slot replacement; the round-trip and interrupted-save gates pass.
